purpose: Evaluate whether the exposure-correlated simulation comparison changes with the empirical state panel or with prespecified aggregate-confounding parameters.

panels.full: 50 states and the District of Columbia

state_panel_sensitivity.rule: Apply the same DGP construction separately to the exposure profile and rank-two residual geometry of each state panel. Hold the causal target and all scalar calibration parameters fixed.

confounding_grid.rule: Use common random numbers across all nine cells. Change only the aggregate-shock correlation coefficient and the outcome-shock loading scale.

acceptance_checks: The restricted panel contains 49 jurisdictions and the full panel contains 51 jurisdictions.
The restricted baseline cell reproduces the principal simulation within 1e-10.
Independent reruns produce numerically equivalent analytical CSV files.
No parameter is selected or changed after results are observed.
